effect.name: GM Color Swap
effect.desc: Three independent find-and-replace slots. Each one matches a colour by RGB distance, hue or luminance, with its own tolerance and soft edge, and swaps it for whatever you pick - so you can repaint a whole grade by targeting three key colours. Hue Only keeps the original brightness and takes just the new hue, which is what stops a skin tone from turning into flat paint. A global saturation boost and a strength control sit on top. Layer space throughout, so the replacement travels with the layer.
